name: Single sign-on (SAML)
notes: Requires customer IdP metadata and test environment access.

name: CRM sync (standard connector)
notes: Supports Salesforce and HubSpot; other CRMs on request.

name: Accounting sync (standard connector)
notes: QuickBooks and Xero supported out of the box.

name: Custom ERP connector
notes: Not on the roadmap; requires a custom SOW.

name: Data migration from CSV templates
notes: Customer must provide data using Brightpath CSV templates.

name: Migration from a legacy database
notes: Non-standard; requires implementation scoping and additional SOW.

name: Workflow configuration (up to 10)
notes: Up to 10 custom workflow rules included in standard onboarding.

name: Go-live, standard implementation
notes: Standard 45-day implementation track assumes customer readiness.

name: Admin training (two sessions)
notes: Two 90-minute remote sessions included in all plans.

name: On-site training
notes: Non-standard; travel and logistics must be agreed in advance.

name: Premium support (4-hour response)
notes: Non-standard add-on; must be included in the order form.
